description.en: How to say hello, thank you and goodbye: the words Poppy says every day.
description.sl: Kako pozdraviš, se zahvališ in posloviš: besede, ki jih Poppy reče vsak dan.
description.it: Come salutare, ringraziare e congedarsi: le parole che Poppy dice ogni giorno.
description.de: Wie du grüßt, dich bedankst und verabschiedest: die Wörter, die Poppy jeden Tag sagt.

words.note: Hello is fine for everyone; hi is shorter and more casual.
words.note_sl: Hello je primeren za vsakogar; hi je krajši in bolj sproščen.
words.note_it: Hello va bene con tutti; hi è più breve e informale.
words.note_de: Hello passt immer; hi ist kürzer und lockerer.

words.note: Said until about twelve; after that, good afternoon.
words.note_sl: Rečeš ga do približno poldneva; potem good afternoon.
words.note_it: Si dice fino a mezzogiorno circa; dopo, good afternoon.
words.note_de: Sagt man bis etwa zwölf Uhr; danach good afternoon.

words.example_en: Good afternoon, Mrs Birkett. How are you?
words.example_sl: Dober dan, gospa Birkett. Kako ste?
words.example_it: Buon pomeriggio, signora Birkett. Come sta?
words.example_de: Guten Tag, Frau Birkett. Wie geht es Ihnen?
words.note: From twelve until about six in the evening.
words.note_sl: Od poldneva do približno šestih zvečer.
words.note_it: Da mezzogiorno fino alle sei di sera circa.
words.note_de: Von zwölf Uhr bis etwa sechs Uhr abends.

words.note: A hello in the evening, when you arrive.
words.note_sl: Pozdrav zvečer, ko prideš.
words.note_it: Un saluto di sera, quando arrivi.
words.note_de: Ein Gruß am Abend, wenn du ankommst.

words.note: Only when you leave at night or go to bed, never as hello.
words.note_sl: Samo ko zvečer odideš ali greš spat, nikoli za pozdrav ob prihodu.
words.note_it: Solo quando vai via di sera o vai a dormire, mai per salutare quando arrivi.
words.note_de: Nur wenn du abends gehst oder schlafen gehst, nie zur Begrüßung.

words.note: A little formal; to friends you say bye.
words.note_sl: Malo bolj uradno; prijateljem rečeš bye.
words.note_it: Un po' formale; agli amici dici bye.
words.note_de: Etwas förmlich; zu Freunden sagst du bye.

words.note: Short for goodbye, between friends. Also: see you!
words.note_sl: Krajše za goodbye, med prijatelji. Tudi: see you!
words.note_it: Forma breve di goodbye, tra amici. Anche: see you!
words.note_de: Kurz für goodbye, unter Freunden. Auch: see you!

words.example_it: Una tazza di tè, per favore.
words.note: The British say please a lot: to friends, in the shop, at the table.
words.note_sl: Britanci pogosto rečejo please: prijateljem, v trgovini, pri mizi.
words.note_it: I britannici dicono please molto spesso: agli amici, nei negozi, a tavola.
words.note_de: Die Briten sagen oft please: zu Freunden, im Laden, am Tisch.

words.note: Thanks is shorter, for every day.
words.note_sl: Thanks je krajše, za vsak dan.
words.note_it: Thanks è più breve, per tutti i giorni.
words.note_de: Thanks ist kürzer, für jeden Tag.

words.example_en: Thank you very much for the jumper!
words.note: Jumper is British; Americans say sweater.
words.note_sl: Jumper je britansko; Američani rečejo sweater.
words.note_it: Jumper è britannico; gli americani dicono sweater.
words.note_de: Jumper ist britisch; Amerikaner sagen sweater.

words.note: The answer to thank you. Never please here!
words.note_sl: Odgovor na thank you. Ne reci please, čeprav po slovensko rečeš »prosim«!
words.note_it: La risposta a thank you. Mai please!
words.note_de: Die Antwort auf thank you. Nicht please, auch wenn man auf Deutsch »bitte« sagt!

words.example_de: Tut mir leid, ich komme zu spät!
words.note: When you did something wrong. The British say sorry a lot!
words.note_sl: Ko si nekaj {m:naredil|f:naredila} narobe. Britanci zelo pogosto rečejo sorry!
words.note_it: Quando hai sbagliato qualcosa. I britannici dicono sorry molto spesso!
words.note_de: Wenn du etwas falsch gemacht hast. Die Briten sagen sehr oft sorry!

words.example_en: Excuse me, where is the Packhorse Inn?
words.example_sl: Oprostite, kje je gostilna Packhorse Inn?
words.example_it: Mi scusi, dov'è il Packhorse Inn?
words.example_de: Entschuldigung, wo ist das Packhorse Inn?
words.note: Before you ask a stranger something, or to get past. Sorry is for a mistake.
words.note_sl: Preden neznanca nekaj vprašaš ali ko greš mimo. Sorry je za napako.
words.note_it: Prima di chiedere qualcosa a uno sconosciuto, o per passare. Sorry è per uno sbaglio.
words.note_de: Bevor du einen Fremden etwas fragst oder um vorbeizukommen. Sorry ist für einen Fehler.

words.note: Yes, please: to take what someone offers. In Cumbria you also hear aye (yes).
words.note_sl: Yes, please: ko sprejmeš, kar ti ponudijo. V Cumbrii slišiš tudi aye (ja).
words.note_it: Yes, please: quando accetti quello che ti offrono. In Cumbria si sente anche aye (sì).
words.note_de: Yes, please: wenn du etwas Angebotenes annimmst. In Cumbria hörst du auch aye (ja).

words.note: One you for everyone: you say How are you? to Mr Tyson too. The answer is short: Fine, thanks.
words.note_sl: En you za vse: tudi gospodu Tysonu rečeš How are you? Odgovor je kratek: Fine, thanks.
words.note_it: Un solo you per tutti: anche al signor Tyson dici How are you? La risposta è breve: Fine, thanks.
words.note_de: Ein you für alle: Auch zu Herrn Tyson sagst du How are you? Die Antwort ist kurz: Fine, thanks.

words.note: Short and friendly, even on a bad day! Also: Not bad, thanks.
words.note_sl: Kratko in prijazno, tudi na slab dan! Tudi: Not bad, thanks.
words.note_it: Breve e gentile, anche in una brutta giornata! Anche: Not bad, thanks.
words.note_de: Kurz und freundlich, auch an einem schlechten Tag! Auch: Not bad, thanks.

words.note: Or simply: I'm Poppy.
words.note_sl: Ali preprosto: I'm Poppy.
words.note_it: Oppure semplicemente: I'm Poppy.
words.note_de: Oder einfach: I'm Poppy.

words.example_sl: Kako ti je ime? Jaz sem Alfie.
words.example_it: Come ti chiami? Io sono Alfie.
words.example_de: Wie heißt du? Ich bin Alfie.
words.note: What's = what is.
words.note_sl: What's = what is.
words.note_it: What's = what is.
words.note_de: What's = what is.

words.example_en: Nice to meet you, Mr Dixon.
words.note: When you meet someone for the first time. The answer: Nice to meet you too.
words.note_sl: Ko nekoga prvič srečaš. Odgovor: Nice to meet you too.
words.note_it: Quando conosci qualcuno per la prima volta. La risposta: Nice to meet you too.
words.note_de: Wenn du jemanden zum ersten Mal triffst. Die Antwort: Nice to meet you too.

words.note: Cumbrian for hello: everyone here says it. It has nothing to do with now.
words.note_sl: Cumbrijski pozdrav: tu ga reče vsak. Z »zdaj« nima nič skupnega.
words.note_it: Il ciao della Cumbria: qui lo dicono tutti. Non c'entra niente con «adesso».
words.note_de: Das Hallo in Cumbria: Hier sagt es jeder. Mit »jetzt« hat es nichts zu tun.

words.note: Welcome! when someone arrives; you're welcome is the answer to thank you.
words.note_sl: Welcome! ob prihodu; you're welcome je odgovor na thank you.
words.note_it: Welcome! quando qualcuno arriva; you're welcome è la risposta a thank you.
words.note_de: Welcome! bei der Ankunft; you're welcome ist die Antwort auf thank you.

words.note: In Britain cheers is a toast, and also an everyday thanks (sometimes even bye).
words.note_sl: V Britaniji je cheers zdravica, pa tudi vsakdanji hvala (včasih celo adijo).
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna cheers è un brindisi, ma anche un grazie di tutti i giorni (a volte perfino ciao).
words.note_de: In Großbritannien ist cheers ein Trinkspruch, aber auch ein alltägliches Danke (manchmal sogar Tschüss).
